requirements.title: Default CHARACTER alignment permits unequal lengths
requirements.source: 8.10.1.3 p1, p2, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF147
requirements.definition: Default CHARACTER objects may share storage only with default CHARACTER or character-SEQUENCE objects, as already constrained by C8115. Their lengths need not match. Nonempty default-character sequences align their first character units; empty sequences associate with one another and with the first character unit of any nonempty sequences. Containing objects can consequently overlap. Only characters whose definition state is established may be referenced.

pending.unequal-length-prefix: PENDING future complete parent: CHARACTER(4) a and CHARACTER(2) b, set (a,b). Execute a='ABCD'; check b=='AB', LEN(a)==4, LEN(b)==2 and each observed character. Then b='XY'; check a=='XYCD'. All four a characters were defined before the partial update. Length and prefix expectations are independent literals, not copies of an expected-value variable.
pending.interior-substring-alignment: PENDING future parent: CHARACTER(4) a, CHARACTER(2) b, EQUIVALENCE (a(2:3),b). Set a='ABCD', observe b=='BC'; set b='XY', observe a=='AXYD'. The prior full definition preserves the outer characters. Bounds are constant and nonzero; C8120 does not prohibit this partial overlap.
pending.array-element-character-order: PENDING future parent: CHARACTER(3) c(2), CHARACTER(4) b; set (b,c(2)). Define c(1)='ABC', c(2)='DEF', then b='GHIJ'. Check c(1)=='ABC', c(2)=='GHI', b=='GHIJ', with individual guards. b's extra fourth character is defined by the b assignment, not assumed present in c. Qualify9.5.3.3 and19.5.3.2/.3 without byte counts.
pending.character-sequence-components: PENDING future parent: public character SEQUENCE type with LEN2 components left,right, ordinary box and CHARACTER(4) word; set (box,word). Define word='ABCD'; check box%left=='AB',box%right=='CD'. Assign box%right='XY'; check word=='ABXY'. Qualify component order, default kind, absence of forbidden components and complete defined character subobjects. The component designators occur in observations, not in the EQUIVALENCE set.
pending.zero-character-bridge: PENDING future source/runtime parent: CHARACTER(0) z, CHARACTER(1) a,b, whole-name sets (z,a),(z,b). Define a='Q' then observe b=='Q'. The zero-length object is not a substring, and19.5.3.3p2 supplies the bridge between the nonzero character units. A LEN(z)==0 or empty-output check alone would not establish association.
pending.all-zero-character-sequences: PENDING bounded source/admission plan for two whole default CHARACTER(0) variables in one set. Establish always-defined empty values and the absence of a first character, but do not mistake comparing two empty strings for an observable alias effect. Documentary/canonical-use machinery is still pending.

The informative LEN4/LEN3 diagram does not define any payload. A future reproduction of its geometry must define all seven participating units before whole-object reads and must not gain duplicate note or generic8.10.1.2 credit. requirements.oracle: Future complete run/effect parents must observe actual associated objects against independent small INTEGER or default CHARACTER literals. Every referenced subobject must already be defined by justified events. Count reached observations, calls and normal returns where applicable; require exact completion stdout, empty runtime stderr and normal exit. Wrong-expectation and observation-omission sensitivity must preserve required definitions and associations, and follow a fresh passing complete parent.

accounting.rationale: The family prohibition repeats canonical C8115 rather than creating another numbered owner. The length permission is qualified by that family and all other restrictions. No canonical-case connection is supplied automatically.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_085.json reads all three original 8.10.1.3 units and their 17 fine units. The default-character family prohibition in p1 restates canonical C8115 and is accounted without creating a second numbered owner; the unequal-length sentence is kept as a permission; p2 carries the default-character storage-sequence association with its first character storage unit and zero-sized bridging conditions, and the illustrated note stays informative. All seven facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
